project_name: Nexus IT Support - Typography Art Direction
context: Typography-only art direction for an existing Slack-like school IT support workspace in PT-BR. No color, layout, or structural changes. Focus on Slack-quality modern, clean, friendly, and professional typography using Inter (with optical size and OpenType features), Newsreader for news headlines, and JetBrains Mono for code/chips.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand value proposition + CTA left with Slack-level typographic balance, seeded live preview cards right
entry_surfaces./workspace: 3-column workspace with left rail, channel list sidebar, central chat message flow, and contextual side panel
entry_surfaces./news: editorial news portal with Newsreader serif headlines, Portuguese categories, and refined article summaries

dark_mode_compensation.principle: In dark mode, letterforms bleed light outwards and appear heavier. Inter weights are calibrated: use 700/800 in dark mode where light mode uses 800/900; ensure anti-aliasing is enabled (subpixel-antialiased or antialiased); maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all secondary copy (#94A3B8 against #070B14 gives 7.2:1 contrast ratio).

news_portuguese_requirements.strict_rule: Every title, category, badge, and date in the news section must be in Brazilian Portuguese.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all heading tracking from '-0.045em' or overly compressed letter-spacing to the balanced values in this guide (maximum -0.025em for H1, -0.02em for H2, -0.015em for H3).
2. Ensure @fontsource-variable/inter and @fontsource-variable/newsreader and @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono are correctly imported in /app/frontend/src/index.css.

3. Set CSS variables --font-sans: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; --font-heading: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; --font-newsreader: 'Newsreader Variable', serif; --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace;
4. Apply font-feature-settings: 'cv02', 'cv03', 'cv04', 'cv11', 'ss01' globally to Inter for Slack-style friendly and open letterforms.
5. Use 'Newsreader Variable' (font-serif) ONLY for News section headlines. All other headlines, navigation, buttons, and chat messages MUST use Inter.
6. Apply 'tabular-nums' to all metrics, KPI counters, ticket IDs, and timestamp displays.
7. DO NOT change layout grids, container structures, or color palettes (#070B14 dark, #F8FAFC light, #00E5FF / #0284C7 cyan accents).
8. Ensure every interactive element retains its data-testid attributes for testing compatibility.
9. Audit all text in the News section to guarantee 100% PT-BR compliance.
